# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
# Leaves, round 3: what makes a mob jump while walking, where a player's server-side fall is counted, game test spawning.
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.control.MoveControl ^(tick|setWantedPosition)$
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.control.JumpControl .
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob ^(removeFreeWill|getJumpControl|checkDespawn|setNoAi)$
calls net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper ^(spawn|spawnWithNoFreeWill|moveTo|walkTo|randomTick|onEachTick|runAfterDelay|succeedWhen)$
findcalls doCheckFallDamage
member net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player (doCheckFallDamage|checkFallDamage)
member net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity (doCheckFallDamage)
member net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity (doCheckFallDamage)
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player ^(doCheckFallDamage|checkFallDamage)$
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity ^(doCheckFallDamage)$
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity ^(doCheckFallDamage)$
calls net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestServer ^(initServer|tickServer)$
